stop_rule: Stop this round after the finite premises and cost-20 witnesses are reproduced from pinned inputs, adversarial controls pass, and the written argument receives independent algorithmic review; otherwise retain a precise partial result within 60 minutes. Do not expand to unequal-span asymmetric decoders in this round.
